acknowledged_limits: P1 estimates affiliation framing and factual observability effects in fixed split topology after a researcher-seeded executor failure; it does not identify architecture net effect, training source, natural failure prevalence, or months-long responsibility continuity.

P2 short/long changes real sessions, permission partition and handoff cost for the same required artifacts; it is a joint organization intervention, not isolated psychological complexity. Six worker starts yield different repair slack; report remaining budget and actual costs.

Three task families per paper, two requested model IDs and one run per condition support bounded descriptive paired comparisons, not stable population rates or general equivalence from zero differences.

Private terminal tests are generated by the same research process and cover finite vectors; independent execution is not independent human content validation. Public test passing and hidden acceptance remain separate outcomes.

CLI conversation is reconstructed full role history, not historical production session replay; fixed seeded failures and scripted initial executor must stay distinct from natural model-generated failures.

No-active/no-file-change counts include useful information actions; observed responsibility externalization requires separate source-grounded exploratory coding, not automatic inference from this count or budget exhaustion.
No external-authorization requirement exists in main tasks; legal external-escalation sensitivity is not estimated. Forty-dollar dispatch threshold is not a hard total spending cap.
